audit_a.method: Imported PIAs/collect_content.py from work/pia-venv/bin/python and called fetch plus discover_list for each supplied English/French list URL. Network responses were cached by the collector under work/pia_content_cache; no collection/source files were edited.

observations: False negative: English DOM h1 is 'Privacy assessments'; h2 sections are 'Privacy impact assessment', 'Privacy compliance evaluation', 'Privacy protocol assessment', then 'Privacy assessment summaries'. The per-program links are nested under the latter h2's year <summary> disclosures (2025–2026, etc.). list_scope selects the first h2 ('Privacy impact assessment') as its focused scope; section() stops at the next h2, so it never sees the actual PIA summary list.

French has the analogous structure: h1 'Sommaires d’évaluations des facteurs relatifs à la vie privée'; h2 'Évaluation des facteurs relatifs à la vie privée' precedes h2 'Sommaires d’évaluations de la protection de la vie privée' with year disclosures. list_scope likewise chooses the first assessment heading and returns zero records.

The actual list heading uses 'Privacy assessment summaries' / 'Sommaires d’évaluations de la protection de la vie privée', not the exact 'Privacy impact assessment summaries' wording expected by list_scope. Prefer a same-page summary subsection when present, including headings that include 'assessment'/'évaluation' + 'summary/sommaire', over a general PIA section.

collector_issue.observed_dom_cause: Assessment titles are h3s nested under month h2s; discover() treats the annual h1 as the PIA scope. Its depth guard rejects each h3 because level 3 is deeper than scope level + 1, as the prior h2 is a month rather than a year heading. It instead passes the month h2s, extracting one oversized inline record per month titled with the month name.
collector_issue.fix_hint: For annual-report layout, recognize each h3 child of a month h2 as an individual inline assessment. Use its native h3 id as the fragment and collect prose through the following peer/shallower heading. The 12 observed assessment h3 headings are stable in both languages and share native IDs, enabling bilingual pairing.
collector_issue.unexpected_links: A Cúram section cross-links the prior-year original PAITS (likely relevant context), while the French report also contains an external Public Safety Canada privacy-list link, which is unrelated to an ESDC inline assessment and is currently emitted as an ESDC page record.
